          }
          case 'SETTING': {
            if (input.derived_sku === null) throw new Error(`redirects: ${fromPath} has no setting variant SKU`);
            return withQuery(`/settings/${input.derived_sku}`, 301, `${REASON_PREFIX}: setting -> /settings/{sku}${preserved}`);
          }
          case 'UNKNOWN':
            return { from_path: fromPath, to_path: fromPath, status_code: 410, reason: 'doc 34 §2 410: no canonical entity in the migrated catalogue (parser did not resolve this family); no useful replacement target exists — honest removal, not a redirect to an unrelated page' };
          case 'EDUCATION':
            return identityOrMapped(`${REASON_PREFIX}: /education/** route shape unchanged — served directly (doc 34 §2: 200, no redirect)`);
          case 'VARIETY_INDEX':
            // Deliberately NOT returned here: the parser classes every depth-1
            // route as VARIETY_INDEX, including /mens-gemstone-ring-settings,
            // which §3 maps to a 302. Fall through to the §3 path rules, where
            // the depth-1 index fallback yields the correct identity mapping.
            break;
          default:
            break;
        }
      
        // Remaining families (category indexes and functional routes) are decided
        // by exact route shape, per §3.
        if (pathname === '/') return identityOrMapped('root route shape unchanged — served directly (doc 34 §2: 200, no redirect)');
        if (pathname === '/cart') return identityOrMapped(`${REASON_PREFIX}: /cart route shape unchanged — served directly`);
        if (pathname === '/account') return identityOrMapped(`${REASON_PREFIX}: /account route shape unchanged — served directly`);
        if (pathname === '/favorites') return identityOrMapped(`${REASON_PREFIX}: /favorites route shape unchanged — served directly`);
        if (pathname === '/financing') return identityOrMapped(`${REASON_PREFIX}: /financing route shape unchanged — served directly`);
        if (pathname === '/blog') return identityOrMapped(`${REASON_PREFIX}: /blog route shape unchanged — served directly`);
        if (pathname === '/auth') return withQuery('/account/sign-in', 301, `${REASON_PREFIX}: /auth -> /account/sign-in`);
        if (pathname === '/verify-email') return withQuery('/account/verify-email', 301, `${REASON_PREFIX}: /verify-email -> /account/verify-email`);
        if (pathname === '/cart/order-summary') return withQuery('/checkout/order-summary', 301, `${REASON_PREFIX}: /cart/order-summary -> /checkout/order-summary`);
        if (pathname === '/cart/payment-order') return withQuery('/checkout/payment-order', 301, `${REASON_PREFIX}: /cart/payment-order -> /checkout/payment-order`);
        if (pathname === '/cart/secure-payment') return withQuery('/checkout/secure-payment', 301, `${REASON_PREFIX}: /cart/secure-payment -> /checkout/secure-payment`);
        if (pathname === '/compare-list') return withQuery('/compare', 301, `${REASON_PREFIX}: /compare-list -> /compare`);
        if (pathname === '/contact-us') return withQuery('/contact', 301, `${REASON_PREFIX}: /contact-us -> /contact`);
        if (pathname === '/extend-protection-plan') return withQuery('/protection-plan', 301, `${REASON_PREFIX}: /extend-protection-plan -> /protection-plan`);
        if (pathname === '/custom-design-gemstone-rings-jewelry') return withQuery('/design-your-own', 301, `${REASON_PREFIX}: /custom-design-gemstone-rings-jewelry -> /design-your-own`);
        if (pathname === '/meet-our-team') return withQuery('/about/meet-our-team', 301, `${REASON_PREFIX}: /meet-our-team -> /about/{slug}`);
        if (pathname === '/michael-arnstein') return withQuery('/about/michael-arnstein', 301, `${REASON_PREFIX}: /michael-arnstein -> /about/{slug}`);
        if (pathname === '/showroom' || pathname.startsWith('/showroom/')) {
          return withQuery(pathname.replace(/^\/showroom/, '/showrooms'), 301, `${REASON_PREFIX}: /showroom/** -> /showrooms/**`);
        }
        if (pathname === '/mens-gemstone-ring-settings') return withQuery('/settings?style=mens', 302, `${REASON_PREFIX}: /mens-gemstone-ring-settings -> /settings?style=mens (temporary, doc 34 §2)`);
        if (pathname === '/gemstone-bracelet-settings') return withQuery('/settings', 301, `${REASON_PREFIX}: /gemstone-bracelet-settings -> /settings (route differs, doc 34 §2 301)`);
        if (pathname === '/sitemap-static.xml') return { from_path: fromPath, to_path: '/sitemap.xml', status_code: 301, reason: `${REASON_PREFIX}: sitemap-static.xml -> /sitemap.xml (target generated by the new site)` };
        const sitemapProduct = /^\/sitemap-products-(\d+)\.xml$/.exec(pathname);
        if (sitemapProduct !== null) {
          return { from_path: fromPath, to_path: `/sitemap-products/${sitemapProduct[1] ?? ''}.xml`, status_code: 301, reason: `${REASON_PREFIX}: sitemap-products-N.xml -> /sitemap-products/N.xml (target generated by the new site)` };
        }
        if (pathname.startsWith('/all-')) return withQuery('/search?collection=all', 302, `${REASON_PREFIX}: /all-* -> /search?collection=all (temporary, doc 34 §2)`);
        if (pathname.startsWith('/gemstone-') && !pathname.includes('/')) {
          return identityOrMapped(`${REASON_PREFIX}: /gemstone-* category index route shape unchanged — served directly`);
        }
        const colourIndex = /^\/([a-z0-9-]+)-gemstones$/.exec(pathname);
        if (colourIndex !== null) {
          const colour = colourIndex[1] ?? '';
          return withQuery(`/colour/${colour}`, 301, `${REASON_PREFIX}: /{colour}-gemstones -> /colour/{colour}`);
        }
        if (pathname.startsWith('/') && !pathname.slice(1).includes('/')) {
          // remaining depth-1 index routes: /{variety}, /{variety}-pairs, /{variety}-rings
          return identityOrMapped(`${REASON_PREFIX}: variety/category index route shape unchanged — served directly`);
        }
        throw new Error(`redirects: no 13.1 rule maps ${fromPath} (family ${input.url_family})`);
      }
      
      /** Execute the redirect-generation stage (corpus mode holds the count). */
      export async function runCmsRedirects(ctx: StageContext, options?: { corpus?: boolean }): Promise<{
        readonly rows: number;
        readonly inserted: number;
        readonly byStatus: string;
        readonly byFamily: string;
      }> {
        const db = ctx.db;
      
        const productSlugs = new Map<string, string>();
        for (const row of (await db.query<{ source_url: string; slug: string }>('SELECT source_url, slug FROM products')).rows) {
          productSlugs.set(row.source_url, row.slug);
        }
      
        const parsed = (await db.query<{
          url_family: string;
          source_url: string;
          derived_sku: string | null;
          design_code: string | null;
          gem_ref_derived: string | null;
        }>('SELECT url_family, source_url, derived_sku, design_code, gem_ref_derived FROM staging_parsed_urls ORDER BY source_url')).rows;
      
        const rows: RedirectRow[] = parsed.map((row) => mapRedirect({
          url_family: row.url_family,
          source_url: row.source_url,
          derived_sku: row.derived_sku,
          design_code: row.design_code,
          gem_ref_derived: row.gem_ref_derived,
          product_slug: productSlugs.get(row.source_url) ?? null,
        }));
      
        // collision + uniqueness gate: one row per source URL, no duplicate from_path.
        const seen = new Set<string>();
        for (const row of rows) {
          if (seen.has(row.from_path)) {
            throw new Error(`redirects: duplicate source path ${row.from_path}`);
          }
          seen.add(row.from_path);
          if (!row.to_path.startsWith('/')) {
            throw new Error(`redirects: target ${row.to_path} is not an absolute path (from ${row.from_path})`);
          }
          if (row.status_code === 200 && row.to_path !== row.from_path) {
            throw new Error(`redirects: identity row ${row.from_path} points at ${row.to_path}`);
          }
        }
      
        if (options?.corpus !== false && rows.length !== EXPECTED_REDIRECTS) {
          throw new Error(`redirects: mapped ${rows.length} source URLs, expected the spine's ${EXPECTED_REDIRECTS}`);
        }
      
        // Destination validity (doc 34 §1): every 301/302 target must resolve.
        // Checked in TypeScript against the canonical tables rather than with an
        // opaque SQL pattern list: settings resolve by variant SKU, ready-made
        // products by `products.slug`, loose stones and pairs by their canonical
        // gem_ref (their slug evidence is the source URL), DYO by product SKU,
        // and the remaining targets are §3 routes that are structural by design.
        const variantSkus = new Set((await db.query<{ sku: string }>('SELECT sku FROM setting_variants')).rows.map((r) => r.sku));
        const productSlugSet = new Set(productSlugs.values());
        const dyoCodes = new Set<string>();
        for (const row of (await db.query<{ source_sku: string | null; source_sku_derived: string | null }>(
          'SELECT source_sku, source_sku_derived FROM products',
        )).rows) {
          for (const code of [row.source_sku, row.source_sku_derived]) {
            if (code !== null && code.length > 0) dyoCodes.add(code.toUpperCase());
          }
        }
        const gemRefs = new Set((await db.query<{ gem_ref: string }>('SELECT gem_ref FROM gemstones')).rows.map((r) => r.gem_ref.toUpperCase()));
        const stoneSlugs = new Set<string>();
        for (const row of parsed) {
          if (row.url_family !== 'LOOSE_STONE' && row.url_family !== 'STONE_PAIR') continue;
          const gemRef = (row.gem_ref_derived ?? '').toUpperCase();
          if (gemRef.length === 0 || !gemRefs.has(gemRef)) continue;
          const slug = sourceSlugOf(new URL(row.source_url).pathname);
          if (slug !== null) stoneSlugs.add(slug);
        }
        const structuralTargets = new Set([
          '/settings',
          '/design-your-own',
          '/compare',
          '/contact',
          '/protection-plan',
          '/account/sign-in',
          '/account/verify-email',
          '/showrooms',
        ]);
        // Depth-1 index routes (variety, category and collection indexes) are
        // observed source routes that §13.2 keeps in the new site, so a target on
        // one of them resolves — including with an explicitly mapped parameter
        // (`/gemstone-ring-settings?style=109`, doc 34 §4).
        const indexPaths = new Set<string>();
        for (const row of parsed) {
          const pathname = new URL(row.source_url).pathname;
          if (pathname.startsWith('/') && !pathname.slice(1).includes('/')) indexPaths.add(pathname);
        }
        const dangling: string[] = [];
        for (const row of rows) {
          if (row.status_code !== 301 && row.status_code !== 302) continue;
          const target = row.to_path.split('?')[0] ?? row.to_path;
          const ok =
            structuralTargets.has(target)
            || indexPaths.has(target)
            || target.startsWith('/checkout/')
            || target.startsWith('/about/')
            || target.startsWith('/showrooms/')
            || target.startsWith('/colour/')
            || target === '/sitemap.xml'
            || target.startsWith('/sitemap-products/')
            || (target.startsWith('/settings/') && variantSkus.has(target.slice('/settings/'.length)))
            || (target.startsWith('/products/') && productSlugSet.has(target.slice('/products/'.length)))
            || (target.startsWith('/products/') && stoneSlugs.has(target.slice('/products/'.length)))
            || (target.startsWith('/design-your-own/review/') && dyoCodes.has(target.slice('/design-your-own/review/'.length).toUpperCase()))
            || (target.startsWith('/search') && row.to_path.includes('collection=all'));
          if (!ok) dangling.push(`${row.from_path} -> ${row.to_path}`);
        }
        if (dangling.length > 0) {
          throw new Error(`redirects: ${String(dangling.length)} redirect target(s) do not resolve (doc 34 §1), e.g. ${dangling.slice(0, 3).join(', ')}`);
        }
      
        // insert (NOT EXISTS by from_path; the table's unique key)
        let inserted = 0;
        const BATCH = 5_000;
        for (let start = 0; start < rows.length; start += BATCH) {
          const batch = rows.slice(start, start + BATCH);
          const result = await db.query(
            `INSERT INTO redirects (from_path, to_path, status_code, reason)
             SELECT x->>'from', x->>'to', (x->>'status')::smallint, x->>'reason'
               FROM jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) AS x
              WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM redirects r WHERE r.from_path = x->>'from')`,
            [JSON.stringify(batch.map((r) => ({ from: r.from_path, to: r.to_path, status: r.status_code, reason: r.reason })))],
          );
          inserted += result.rowCount ?? 0;
        }
      
        // determinism check on pre-existing rows.
        const disagree = await db.query<{ n: string }>(
          `SELECT count(*)::text AS n
             FROM redirects r
             JOIN jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) AS x ON x->>'from' = r.from_path
            WHERE r.to_path <> x->>'to' OR r.status_code <> (x->>'status')::smallint`,
          [JSON.stringify(rows.map((r) => ({ from: r.from_path, to: r.to_path, status: r.status_code })))],
        );
        if (Number(disagree.rows[0]?.n ?? '0') !== 0) {
          throw new Error('redirects: a stored redirect disagrees with the recomputed 13.1 mapping (determinism violation)');
      
        }
      
        const total = await db.query<{ n: string }>('SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM redirects');
        if (Number(total.rows[0]?.n ?? '0') !== rows.length) {
          throw new Error(`redirects: ${String(total.rows[0]?.n)} redirect rows exist for ${String(rows.length)} source URLs`);
        }
      
        const byStatus = new Map<number, number>();
        const byFamily = new Map<string, number>();
        for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i += 1) {
          const row = rows[i];
          if (row === undefined) continue;
          byStatus.set(row.status_code, (byStatus.get(row.status_code) ?? 0) + 1);
          const family = parsed[i]?.url_family ?? 'UNKNOWN';
          byFamily.set(family, (byFamily.get(family) ?? 0) + 1);
        }
        const fmt = (m: Map<string | number, number>): string =>
          [...m.entries()].sort((a, b) => String(a[0]).localeCompare(String(b[0]))).map(([k, v]) => `${String(k)}=${String(v)}`).join(' ');
      
        return { rows: rows.length, inserted, byStatus: fmt(byStatus), byFamily: fmt(byFamily) };
      }

#
# This service is DEVELOPMENT ONLY. It is disposable. It holds no real data
# ever: synthetic data everywhere, including staging (technical_design/32 rule 8).
#
# The password below is a local-only throwaway credential for a container that
# binds to localhost only. It is NOT a repository secret: production secrets
# live in the platform secret manager (AGENTS.md section 10) and never here.
# =============================================================================

services:
  db:
    image: pgvector/pgvector:pg16
    container_name: maihan-dev-db
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      # Local-throwaway credential. Never reuse outside the container.
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: maihan_local_dev_only
      POSTGRES_DB: maihan_dev
    ports:
      # Bind to localhost only — never expose to the network.
      - '127.0.0.1:5433:5432'
    volumes:
      - maihan_dev_dbdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD-SHELL', 'pg_isready -U postgres -d maihan_dev']
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10

volumes:

      ## 12. FRONTEND ARCHITECTURE
      
      ### 12.1 Principles
      
      1. **Data-driven.** No page is created per product, variety or category. Every catalog page renders from the same components plus data. `[INFERRED]` from charter 49.
      2. **Server-first.** Anything not requiring interactivity is a Server Component.
      3. **Client islands only where interaction demands it.** DYO, chat, WebAR, filters, cart.
      4. **Domain APIs are the only data source.** The frontend never parses source slugs or reconstructs SKU grammar.
      5. **Loading, error and empty states are designed, not defaulted.**
      
      ### 12.2 Route tree
      
      ```
      app/
        (storefront)/
          layout.tsx                       # header, mega menu, footer, chat launcher
          page.tsx                         # /
          [variety]/page.tsx               # /tsavorite-garnet           (loose stones)
          [variety]/not-found.tsx
          [variety]-pairs/page.tsx         # /tsavorite-garnet-pairs
          [variety]-rings/page.tsx         # /tsavorite-garnet-rings
          [variety]-rings/[slug]/page.tsx  # /tsavorite-garnet-rings/<slug>   (ready-made)
          colour/[colour]/page.tsx         # /padparadscha-gemstones
          settings/page.tsx                # /gemstone-rings  (settings catalog)
          settings/[sku]/page.tsx          # /gemstone-ring-settings/<slug>
          search/page.tsx                  # /search
          products/[slug]/page.tsx         # canonical product detail
          design-your-own/page.tsx         # /design-your-own       (entry)
          design-your-own/review/[code]/page.tsx   # /design-your-own/review/<code>
          ar/[assetId]/page.tsx            # /ar/<assetId>          (WebAR, isolated)
          ar/handoff/[token]/page.tsx      # QR target
          compare/page.tsx                 # /compare-list
          favorites/page.tsx               # /favorites
          cart/page.tsx                    # /cart
          checkout/order-summary/page.tsx  # /checkout/order-summary
          checkout/payment-order/page.tsx  # /checkout/payment-order
          checkout/secure-payment/page.tsx # /checkout/secure-payment
          account/...
          contact/page.tsx                 # /contact-us
          showrooms/page.tsx               # /showroom
          showrooms/[slug]/page.tsx        # /showroom/preview
          education/...
          blog/...
          policy/[slug]/page.tsx
        admin/                             # separate layout, separate authz
        api/                               # route handlers, section 11
      ```
      
      ### 12.3 Server and client boundary
      
      | Surface | Rendering | Reason |
      |---|---|---|
      | Home, variety, colour, category, settings index | Server | SEO, cacheable, no per-user state |
      | Product detail | Server shell + client islands | SEO-critical content; gallery, DYO CTA, AR button interactive |
      | Search results | Server for first page, client for refinements | SEO plus interactivity |
      | DYO configurator | Client | Multi-step stateful interaction |
      | Cart and checkout | Client-heavy, server-validated | Money and inventory |
      | Chat | Client island, lazy | Never in the initial bundle |
      | WebAR | Client only, dynamic import, no SSR | GPU and camera |
      | Account | Server | Per-user, non-cacheable |
      | Admin | Client | Dense interactive tables |
      
      ### 12.4 Component architecture
      
      ```
      components/
        design-system/        # primitives: Button, Input, Select, Dialog, Sheet, Tabs,
                              # Badge, Card, Table, Toast, Skeleton, Price, Money
        catalog/              # ProductCard, ProductGrid, ProductGallery, SpecTable,
                              # StoneSpecPanel, StoneFacetChips, CertificateBadge,
                              # AvailabilityBadge, ProvenanceBadge
        filters/              # FacetPanel, FacetGroup, FacetCheckbox, RangeSlider,
                              # ActiveFilterChips, SortSelect, MobileFilterSheet
        dyo/                  # StonePicker, SettingPicker, MetalPicker, SizePicker,
                              # CompatibilityPanel, PriceBreakdown, ReviewStep,
                              # ConfigurationSummary, ShareButton
        cart/                 # CartLine, CartSummary, QuantityStepper, AddOnSelector
        checkout/             # CheckoutSteps, AddressForm, ShippingSelector,
                              # PaymentForm, OrderReview, FinancingSelector
        ai/                   # ChatPanel, ChatMessage, ToolTrace, CitationChip,
                              # HandoffNotice, FeedbackWidget
        documents/            # CertificateCard, CertificateField, ConfidenceBadge,
                              # VerificationBadge, DocumentViewer
        ar/                   # ARLauncher, ARViewer, HandTrackingStatus, DeviceFallback,
                              # QrHandoff, CalibrationPrompt
        layout/               # Header, MegaMenu, MobileNav, Footer, AnnouncementBar,
                              # Breadcrumbs, LocaleSwitcher
        cms/                  # block renderers, one per content_block_type
        account/              # OrderCard, AddressCard, ProfileForm, WishlistGrid
      ```
      
      Rules: no component imports a repository or calls the database; components receive view models from the server layer; one component per file; no page-local copies of design-system components.
      
      ### 12.5 State management
      
      | State | Mechanism | Rationale |
      |---|---|---|
      | Server data | Server Components + `fetch` cache tags | Revalidation by tag; no client cache duplication |
      | URL state | `searchParams` | Filters, sort and pagination are shareable and back-button safe |
      | DYO draft | Client reducer + server persistence | Explicit state machine; Redis for the live session, Postgres for the durable record |
      | Cart | Server-authoritative, client-optimistic | Money correctness beats instant feedback |
      | Chat | Server stream + client transcript | Streaming is inherently server-driven |
      | Filters | URL + `useOptimistic` | Shareability is a feature |
      | AR | Client-only store, never global | Isolated to the AR route |
      
      ### 12.6 Data fetching and caching
      
      ```ts
      // Server Component read with explicit tags for event-driven invalidation.
      const product = await getProductBySlug(slug, { tags: [`product:${slug}`] });
      ```
      
      Tag strategy: `product:{slug}`, `gemstone:{gemRef}`, `variety:{slug}`, `taxonomy`, `nav:{key}`, `page:{slug}`, `search:{hash}`. Section 30 defines which event invalidates which tag.
      
      ### 12.7 States
      
      Every data-dependent view implements all four:
      
      | State | Pattern |
      |---|---|
      | Loading | Route-level `loading.tsx` skeleton matching final layout; inline Suspense for islands |
      | Error | Route-level `error.tsx` with a real recovery action, not a bare message |
      | Empty | Purpose-built empty state with a next action: "No tsavorites match these filters. Clear filters" |
      | Not found | `not-found.tsx` with search and category suggestions |
      
      ### 12.8 SEO
      
      - `generateMetadata` per route from `seo_metadata`, falling back to derived title and description.
      - Canonical URL with a single trailing-slash policy. `[OBSERVED]` The source used trailing-slash canonicals; we normalise to no-trailing-slash and 301 the source form.
      - JSON-LD: `Product` with `offers`, `BreadcrumbList`, `Organization` with the observed address and phone, `Article` for education and blog.
      - `[OBSERVED]` The source already emitted Product JSON-LD including `sku`, `mpn`, `brand` and `offers.price`; we reproduce and extend it.
      - Sitemaps generated from `products`, `gemstone_varieties`, `pages`; sharded above 50,000 URLs, matching the source's 44 sharded product sitemaps.
      - `robots.txt` disallowing `/admin`, `/api`, `/ar/handoff`.
      - Redirect table seeded from all 44,218 source URLs (section 33).
      
      ### 12.9 Accessibility
      
      Semantic landmarks; skip link; visible focus rings; the gallery is keyboard-operable with arrow keys; AR controls are large touch targets with `aria-label`; chat is `role="log"` with `aria-live="polite"`; colour contrast at least 4.5:1; all form fields labelled and error-linked via `aria-describedby`; reduced-motion honoured for every animation.
      
      ### 12.10 Analytics
      
      | Event | Properties | Consent |
      |---|---|---|
      | `page_view` | path, template, variety, jewelleryType | required |
      | `search` | query, filters, resultCount, strategy | required |
      | `filter_applied` | facet, value, resultCount | required |
      | `product_view` | slug, variety, price, stoneId | required |
      | `dyo_step` | step, stoneId, settingSku, metal | required |
      | `dyo_completed` | configurationHash, price | required |
      | `add_to_cart` | productId, quantity, price | required |
      | `checkout_step` | step, orderNumber | required |
      | `order_placed` | orderNumber, value | required |
      | `ai_interaction` | surface, toolCalls, handoff | required |
      | `ar_session` | assetId, deviceTier, duration | optional |
      | `certificate_view` | certificateId, verificationStatus | optional |
      
      Analytics is loaded through a thin adapter so the provider can change. No PII in event properties. Server-side events for conversions, so ad blockers do not lose revenue data.
      
      ### 12.11 Performance budget
      
      | Metric | Budget |
      |---|---|
      | Initial JS on a category page | <= 170 KB gzip |
      | Initial JS on a product page | <= 190 KB gzip |
      | Chat bundle | lazy, <= 90 KB gzip, never in the initial payload |
      | WebAR bundle | lazy, <= 650 KB gzip plus lazy 3D assets |
      | Fonts | self-hosted, subset, `font-display: swap`, max 2 families |
      | Images | AVIF then WebP, `srcset`, explicit dimensions to avoid layout shift |
      | Third-party scripts | none on the critical path |

      ### 13.3 Slug strategy
      
      Target slugs preserve the source shape, because it is human-readable, SEO-friendly and already contains the semantic tokens:
      
      ```

            (stable: derived from the source slug, never from a mutable display name)
      ```
      
      Rules: slug changes require a `redirects` row; `product_number` is the stable internal identifier; slugs never embed a mutable price or availability value.

      # 02 TECH STACK
      
      **Package:** `technical_design/` doc 02 of 40
      **Authority:** `PROJECT_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH.md` section 7 (proposed stack), section 29 (deployment).
      **Evidence status:** `[INFERRED]` for every target technology. None is a claim about the source system.
      
      ---
      
      ## Purpose
      
      Fix the exact technology set, its role, and the boundary each one occupies, so that no technology enters the build without a decision record.
      
      ## Locked stack
      
      | Layer | Technology | Version target | Role | Boundary |
      |---|---|---|---|---|
      | Web framework | Next.js (App Router) | current LTS | Storefront, admin, AR route, route handlers | Rendering and HTTP only |
      | Language | TypeScript | 5.x | All application and tooling code | n/a |
      | Runtime | Vercel Node runtime | LTS | `apps/web`, `apps/worker` | Execution environment |
      | Primary database | Neon PostgreSQL | 16+ | Transactional truth, full-text, vectors | `packages/db` only |
      | Vector search | pgvector | 0.6+ | `vector(1024)` plus HNSW | Inside Postgres |
      | Trigram search | pg_trgm | contrib | Typo tolerance | Inside Postgres |
      | Diacritic folding | unaccent | contrib | Search normalisation | Inside Postgres |
      | Case-insensitive text | citext | contrib | `customers.email` | Inside Postgres |
      | Cache / transient | Redis | 7.x | Cache, rate limits, sessions, coordination, locks | Never truth |
      | Object storage | Cloudflare R2 | - | Originals, renditions, private documents | `packages/ai`-free path |
      | Image CDN | ImageKit | - | Format negotiation, resizing, delivery | Public imagery only |
      | ORM / query layer | Drizzle ORM | current | Schema, migrations, typed queries | `packages/db` only |
      | Validation | Zod | 3.x/4.x | DTOs, event schemas, config parsing | Edge of every boundary |
      | AI gateway | Vercel AI Gateway, OpenRouter fallback | - | Model routing behind `ModelGateway` | `packages/ai` only |
      | WhatsApp | Meta WhatsApp Cloud API | - | Channel | `integrations` module |
      | AR hand tracking | MediaPipe HandLandmarker (WASM) | - | 21 landmarks | Browser only |
      | AR rendering | Three.js + WebGL2 | - | PBR scene | Browser only |
      | AR assets | Draco-compressed GLB, KTX2 textures | - | Geometry and textures | R2 + CDN |
      | Observability | OpenTelemetry + Sentry-compatible error reporting | - | Traces, metrics, logs, errors | `packages/observability` |
      
      ## Explicitly NOT in the stack
      
      | Rejected | Reason |
      |---|---|
      | Dedicated search engine (Meilisearch, Algolia, Typesense, Elasticsearch) | ADR-006. Measured catalogue is ~33,000 searchable entities; Postgres meets NFR-03 |
      | Microservices | ADR-019. Modular monolith; extraction requires a named trigger |
      | External vector database | ADR-001, ADR-018. Vectors live with transactional data |
      | ORM beyond Drizzle | Source of Truth section 10.3 names Drizzle as the repository layer |
      | GraphQL | Deferred decision. No over-fetching problem observed |
      | Event broker (Kafka, RabbitMQ) | ADR-020. Transactional outbox in Postgres is sufficient at this scale |
      | Redis as write-through store for orders | ADR-002. Never truth |
      
      ## Open technical decisions
      
      | Decision | Status | Note |
      |---|---|---|
      | **Test runner, E2E driver, load-test tool** | **OPEN — ADR-021** | Source of Truth section 34 specifies test layers and required coverage but names no tool. Not selected here, to avoid introducing an unapproved technology. Must be decided at Phase 1 kickoff, before the first test is written |
      | Component library / design system primitives | **OPEN — ADR-022 candidate** | Source of Truth section 12.4 specifies the component inventory but no library. Recommend building primitives in-repo rather than adopting one, but that is a decision to record |
      | Migration-runner for raw HTML ingest | Deferred | Only if Phase 24 requires re-fetching the 502 shell pages |
      | Email / transactional messaging provider | Deferred decision | Needed by Phase 6 notifications |
      
      Nothing in the "NOT in the stack" table may be introduced without a new ADR superseding the referenced one.
      
      ## Tooling by activity
      
      | Activity | Tool | Package |
      |---|---|---|
      | Lint, boundaries | ESLint with `no-restricted-imports` | repo root |
      | Typecheck | `tsc --noEmit` across all packages | repo root |
      | Unit / domain / integration tests | **OPEN — ADR-021** | per package |
      | E2E | **OPEN — ADR-021** | `apps/web` |
      | Load | **OPEN — ADR-021** | `tools/` |
      | Schema migrations | Drizzle Kit | `packages/db` |
      | Import pipeline | Custom CLI (Node) | `tools/migrate` |
      | Secrets | Platform secret manager (Vercel env) | n/a |
      
      ## Dependency direction for packages
      
      ```
      contracts  <- domain  <- db
      config     <- everything
      observability <- everything
      ai         <- contracts, domain
      ```
      
      `packages/domain` depends on no runtime package. This is what keeps invariants unit-testable without infrastructure.
      
      ## Versioning policy
      
      - Application packages: exact versions, lockfile committed.
      - Extensions: pinned to versions known available on Neon (16+ for the core; contrib extensions from the Neon standard image).
      - Embedding model: single model, single dimension 1024 (ADR-018). A model change is a versioned re-embed job, not a schema change.
      - 3D asset budgets: enforced as data, not as library versions.
      
      ## Inputs / Outputs
      
      **Inputs:** Source of Truth sections 7, 11, 12, 14, 29, 35 (ADRs 001, 002, 006, 018, 019).
      **Outputs:** the table above, which is the sole authority on "may I add this dependency".
      
      ## Validation rules
      
      1. Any new runtime dependency requires an ADR and an entry in this document.
      2. `packages/domain` may declare only Zod (if types need runtime parsing) and nothing else.
      3. No provider SDK may be imported outside `packages/ai` (AI providers), `integrations` (WhatsApp, payments) and `packages/db`.
      4. Browser-only libraries (MediaPipe, Three.js) may not be imported by any server bundle; the AR route enforces `ssr: false`.
      
      ## Testing requirements
      
      A CI job asserts that the declared dependency sets of each package match this document. Drift fails the build.
      
      ## Failure modes
      
      | Failure | Response |
      |---|---|
      | Undeclared dependency added | CI dependency-drift job fails |
      | Browser library leaks into a server bundle | Build-time bundle analysis fails |
      | Test toolchain chosen ad hoc | Blocked: ADR-021 must exist first |
      
      ## Implementation constraints
      
      1. This table is closed. Additions require an ADR.
      2. Removing a locked technology also requires an ADR superseding the original.
      3. Extension availability must be confirmed on the target Neon instance before migration runs, since Phase 0 validated `citext`, `pg_trgm`, `unaccent` and `btree_gin` structurally only.

=== pairs page ===
/**
 * apps/web/src/app/(storefront)/[varietySlug]-pairs/page.tsx
 *
 * `/tsavorite-garnet-pairs` — matched-pair variety listing (Task 3). Same
 * ONE-dynamic-route shape as the variety page, filtered to STONE_PAIR via
 * the Phase 3 port's `kind` filter. No per-variety page exists.
 */
import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation';

import { catalogServer } from '../../../lib/catalog-server.js';
import { listingBasePath, listingQuery, productItems, type ListingParams } from '../../../lib/catalog-view.js';
import { ProductCard } from '../../../components/catalog/ProductCard.js';
import { Breadcrumbs } from '../../../components/design-system/Breadcrumbs.js';
import { EmptyState } from '../../../components/design-system/EmptyState.js';
import { Pagination } from '../../../components/design-system/Pagination.js';

interface PageProps {
  params: Promise<{ varietySlug: string }>;
  searchParams: Promise<ListingParams>;
}

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: PageProps): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { varietySlug } = await params;
  return { title: `${varietySlug.replace(/-/g, ' ')} pairs | Maihan Gems` };
}

export default async function VarietyPairsIndexPage({ params, searchParams }: PageProps) {
  const { varietySlug } = await params;
  const urlParams = await searchParams;
  const query = listingQuery(urlParams);
  const service = catalogServer();

  const taxonomy = (await service.getTaxonomy()).value;
  const variety = taxonomy.varieties.find((v) => v.slug === varietySlug);
  if (variety === undefined || variety.state !== 'ACTIVE') notFound();

  const result = (
    await service.listProducts({
      ...query,
      filters: { variety: [varietySlug], kind: ['STONE_PAIR'] },
    })
  ).value;
  const items = productItems(result);

  return (
    <main className="page variety-pairs-page">
      <Breadcrumbs
        crumbs={[
          { label: 'Home', href: '/' },
          { label: variety.display_name, href: `/${varietySlug}` },
          { label: 'Pairs' },
        ]}
      />
      <h1>{variety.display_name} Pairs</h1>
      <p className="result-count">
        {items.length === 0 ? 'No pairs currently listed.' : `${items.length} pair${items.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} listed`}
      </p>

      {items.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          title={`No ${variety.display_name} pairs are currently listed.`}
          action={<Link href={`/${varietySlug}`}>Browse all {variety.display_name}</Link>}
        />
      ) : (
        <ul className="product-grid">
          {items.map((product) => (
            <li key={product.slug}>
              <ProductCard product={product.summary} />
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}

      <Pagination
        basePath={listingBasePath(`/${varietySlug}-pairs`, urlParams)}
        previousCursor={null}
        nextCursor={result.meta.next_cursor}
        hasNext={result.meta.has_more}
      />
    </main>
  );
}

- path: tools/migrate/src/stages/parse-slug.ts
  content: |
      /**
       * tools/migrate — the deterministic five-family URL/slug classifier and
       * field tokenizer (Phase 2 Global Task 12 = plan detailed tasks 4+5).
       *
       * Plan task 12 (verbatim): "Implement the parse stage: five-family slug
       * classifier writing `staging_parsed_urls` with per-field confidence."
       * Done when gates V1 + V2 hold at 100% and V14 reconciles the per-family
       * counts exactly.
       *
       * Evidence basis (all [VERIFIED] on the corpus, PROJECT_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH.md
       * §2.1 / §4.2 / §33.2, technical_design/34 §3 route map):
       *
       *   LOOSE_STONE   /{variety}/{w}ct-{origin}-{shape}-{colour}-{variety}-K#####
       *   STONE_PAIR    /{variety}-pairs/{w}ct-{origin}-[{shape}-]{variety}-pair-PR#####
       *   SETTING       /gemstone-{ring|necklace-pendant|earring}-settings/
       *                  {metalPhrase}-{styleTokens}-setting-js<core><metal>
       *   DYO           /design-your-own/review/
       *                  [{tokens}]-{w}ct-{metalPhrase}-js<core><metal>-{K|PR}<digits>
       *   READY_MADE    /{variety}-rings/{slug}-J#####    (the 88 observed items)
       *
       * Non-commerce families land in the schema's full url_family enumeration
       * (VARIETY_INDEX, CATEGORY_INDEX, FUNCTIONAL, EDUCATION). A URL matching NO
       * documented shape is family UNKNOWN with explicit warnings — unknown stays
       * explicitly represented, never silently widened into a guessed family.
       *
       * Per-field ledger: every parsed field carries a confidence in [0,1] and an
       * evidence status; a value normalised from a source string is at most
       * EXTRACTED (doc 05); a field with no evidence is null with UNKNOWN, never
       * a default.
       *
       * Determinism: pure functions of the URL text plus vocabularies derived from
       * the SAME verified corpus in a bounded first pass (origin phrases), so
       * given identical input hashes the parse output is identical.
       */
      import { METAL_SEED } from '@maihan/db';
      import { parseSkuString, parseSkuFromSlug, type MetalCode } from '@maihan/domain';
      
      export const URL_FAMILIES = [
        'LOOSE_STONE',
        'STONE_PAIR',
        'SETTING',
        'DYO',
        'READY_MADE',
        'VARIETY_INDEX',
        'CATEGORY_INDEX',
        'FUNCTIONAL',
        'EDUCATION',
        'UNKNOWN',
      ] as const;
      
      export type UrlFamily = (typeof URL_FAMILIES)[number];
      
      // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // Field evidence + parsed shape
      // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
      
      export interface FieldEvidence {
        /** The structured value; null when no evidence supports a value. */
        readonly value: string | number | null;
        /** Parse confidence in [0,1]; 1.0 = structurally anchored token. */
        readonly confidence: number;
        /** 'EXTRACTED' when a value was deterministically derived from a source
         *  string; 'UNKNOWN' when no evidence produced a value. */
        readonly evidence: 'EXTRACTED' | 'UNKNOWN';
        /** Deterministic parse warning for the field (UNKNOWN cases). */
        readonly warning?: string;
      }
      
      export interface ParsedUrlFields {
        readonly variety: FieldEvidence | null; // slug variety token phrase
        readonly colour: FieldEvidence | null; // colour token phrase (may be multi-token)
        readonly form: string; // 'single' | 'pairs' | 'rings' | 'settings' | 'none'
        readonly stoneWeightCt: FieldEvidence | null; // carats (NUMERIC(8,3))
        readonly origin: FieldEvidence | null; // origin token phrase
        readonly shape: FieldEvidence | null; // stone_shape enum value
        readonly cut: FieldEvidence | null; // cut label phrase
        readonly jewelleryType: FieldEvidence | null; // jewellery_type enum value
        readonly designCode: FieldEvidence | null; // 'JS<core><metal>' derived
        readonly metalCode: FieldEvidence | null; // metal_code enum member
        readonly settingStyle: FieldEvidence | null; // the settings design token
        readonly gemRefDerived: FieldEvidence | null; // from the URL slug only
        readonly gemRefObserved: FieldEvidence | null; // null here; canonical stages join product.sku
        readonly derivedSku: FieldEvidence | null; // composed from the slug grammar (DYO only)
      }
      
      export interface ParsedUrl {
        readonly sourceUrl: string;
        readonly family: UrlFamily;
        readonly routeDepth: number;
        readonly fields: ParsedUrlFields;
        /** Row-level parse warnings (unknown-family reasons etc.). */
        readonly warnings: readonly string[];
        /** Minimum field confidence (row's parse_confidence). */
        readonly confidence: number;
      }
      
      // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // Vocabularies
      // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
      
      /** Exact hyphenated shape token -> stone_shape enum value. */
      const SHAPE_VALUES: ReadonlyMap<string, string> = new Map(
        (
          [
            ['oval', 'OVAL'],
            ['round', 'ROUND'],
            ['cushion', 'CUSHION'],
            ['emerald-cut', 'EMERALD_CUT'],
            ['pear', 'PEAR'],
            ['radiant', 'RADIANT'],
            ['princess', 'PRINCESS'],
            ['heart', 'HEART'],
            ['trillion', 'TRILLION'],
            ['asscher-octagon', 'ASSCHER_OCTAGON'],
            ['baguette', 'BAGUETTE'],
            ['marquise', 'MARQUISE'],
          ] as const
        ).map(([token, value]) => [token, value] as const),
      );
      
      /** Jewellery slug token -> jewellery_type enum member. */
      const JEWELLERY_VALUES: ReadonlyMap<string, string> = new Map(
        (
          [
            ['ring', 'RING'],
            ['earring', 'EARRINGS'],
            ['earrings', 'EARRINGS'],
            ['pendant', 'PENDANT'],
            ['necklace', 'NECKLACE'],
            ['bracelet', 'BRACELET'],
          ] as const
        ).map(([token, value]) => [token, value] as const),
      );
      
      /** Metal slug phrase -> metal_code enum member (the authoritative seed). */
      const METAL_BY_PHRASE: ReadonlyMap<string, MetalCode> = new Map(
        METAL_SEED.map((m) => [m.slugPhrase, m.code] as const),
      );
      
      /** Documented settings route families with their mount jewellery type. */
      export const SETTING_ROUTE_FAMILIES: readonly {
        readonly prefix: string;
        readonly jewellery: 'RING' | 'EARRINGS' | 'PENDANT';
      }[] = Object.freeze([
        { prefix: '/gemstone-ring-settings/', jewellery: 'RING' },
        { prefix: '/gemstone-earring-settings/', jewellery: 'EARRINGS' },
        // Mount family for necklace AND pendant: the design core is a pendant
        // mount; the necklace is the same core realised on a chain. Recorded as a
        // modelling decision (DECISIONS.md, INFERRED) — never presented as observed.
        { prefix: '/gemstone-necklace-pendant-settings/', jewellery: 'PENDANT' },
      ]);
      
      // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // Token helpers
      // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
      
      const WEIGHT_RE = /^(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)ct$/;
      
      function weightValueOf(token: string): number | null {
        const m = WEIGHT_RE.exec(token.toLowerCase());
        return m === null ? null : Number(m[1]);
      }
      
      function isKRef(tail: string): string | null {
        const m = /^-?k(\d+)$/i.exec(tail);
        return m?.[1] ?? null;
      }
      
      function isPrRef(tail: string): string | null {
        const m = /^-?pr(\d+)$/i.exec(tail);
        return m?.[1] ?? null;
      }
      
      function isJRef(tail: string): string | null {
        const m = /^-?j(\d+)$/i.exec(tail);
        return m?.[1] ?? null;
      }
      
      function ev(
        value: string | number | null,
        confidence: number,
        evidence: 'EXTRACTED' | 'UNKNOWN',
        warning?: string,
      ): FieldEvidence {
        return Object.freeze({ value, confidence, evidence, warning });
      }
      
      function emptyFields(): ParsedUrlFields {
        return Object.freeze({
          variety: null,
          colour: null,
          form: 'none',
          stoneWeightCt: null,
          origin: null,
          shape: null,
          cut: null,
          jewelleryType: null,
          designCode: null,
          metalCode: null,
          settingStyle: null,
          gemRefDerived: null,
          gemRefObserved: null,
          derivedSku: null,
        });
      }
      
      function minConfidence(fields: ParsedUrlFields): number {
        let min = 1;
        for (const field of Object.values(fields)) {
          if (field !== null && field !== undefined && typeof field === 'object' && 'confidence' in field) {
            min = Math.min(min, field.confidence);
          }
        }
        return Math.round(min * 1_000) / 1_000;
      }
      
      // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // Origin vocabulary (two-pass, deterministic)
      // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
      
      /**
       * Slugs WITHOUT an exact shape token need a known-origin vocabulary to split
       * their leading token run. Pass 1 derives it from the slugs that DO have a
       * shape: their token run between the weight token and the shape token is the
       * origin phrase, anchored on both sides. The vocabulary is keyed by phrase
       * with an observed usage count. Nothing is invented.
       */
      export function buildOriginVocabulary(paths: readonly string[]): Map<string, { count: number }> {
        const vocab = new Map<string, { count: number }>();
        for (const path of paths) {
          const parsed = looseOrPairBody(path);
          if (parsed === null || parsed.shapeIndex === undefined || parsed.shapeIndex === 0) continue;
          const phrase = parsed.body.slice(0, parsed.shapeIndex).join('-');
          if (phrase.length === 0) continue;
          const hit = vocab.get(phrase);
          if (hit === undefined) vocab.set(phrase, { count: 1 });
          else hit.count += 1;
        }
        return vocab;
      }
      
      
      /**
       * The exact-shape finder: shapes may span tokens when the token text contains
       * a hyphen ('emerald-cut', 'asscher-octagon'), so scanning a dash-split token
       * run must match adjacent 2-token phrases. Returns the START index of the
       * first match, or undefined.
       */
      function findShapeStart(body: readonly string[]): number | undefined {
        for (let i = 0; i < body.length; i += 1) {
          const twoToken = `${body[i] ?? ''}-${body[i + 1] ?? ''}`;
          if (body[i + 1] !== undefined && SHAPE_VALUES.has(twoToken.toLowerCase())) return i;
          if (SHAPE_VALUES.has((body[i] ?? '').toLowerCase())) return i;
        }
        return undefined;
      }
      
      /** The shape match at a start index (adjacent 2-token phrase, then single token). */
      function shapeMatchAt(body: readonly string[], start: number): { value: string; length: number } | null {
        const twoToken = `${body[start] ?? ''}-${body[start + 1] ?? ''}`;
        if (body[start + 1] !== undefined && SHAPE_VALUES.has(twoToken.toLowerCase())) {
          return { value: SHAPE_VALUES.get(twoToken.toLowerCase()) ?? '', length: 2 };
        }
        const single = (body[start] ?? '').toLowerCase();
        if (SHAPE_VALUES.has(single)) return { value: SHAPE_VALUES.get(single) ?? '', length: 1 };
        return null;
      }
      /**
       * Split a loose/pair slug body: first token is the weight; the trailing ref
       * (and, for pairs, the literal 'pair' token) comes off the end. Returns the
       * body tokens between them and an (optional) exact-shape token index.
       */
      function looseOrPairBody(path: string): { body: readonly string[]; shapeIndex?: number; shapeLen: number } | null {
        const segments = path.split('/');
        const slug = segments[segments.length - 1] ?? '';
        const tokens = slug.split('-');
        if (weightValueOf(tokens[0] ?? '') === null) return null;
        const last = tokens[tokens.length - 1] ?? '';
        const k = isKRef(last);
        const pr = isPrRef(last);
        if (k === null && pr === null) return null;
        if (pr !== null) {
          // pair family: '...-{variety tokens}-pair-PR#####'
          if ((tokens[tokens.length - 2] ?? '').toLowerCase() !== 'pair') return null;
          const body = tokens.slice(1, tokens.length - 2);
          const shapeIndex = findShapeStart(body);
          return Object.freeze({ body, shapeIndex, shapeLen: shapeIndex === undefined ? 0 : (shapeMatchAt(body, shapeIndex)?.length ?? 1) });
        }
        const body = tokens.slice(1, tokens.length - 1);
        const shapeIndex = findShapeStart(body);
        return Object.freeze({ body, shapeIndex, shapeLen: shapeIndex === undefined ? 0 : (shapeMatchAt(body, shapeIndex)?.length ?? 1) });
      }
      
      // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // Loose / pair field parsing
      // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
      
      function parseLoosePairFields(
        dir: string,
        slug: string,
        originVocabulary?: ReadonlyMap<string, unknown>,
      ): { fields: ParsedUrlFields; warnings: readonly string[] } {
        const isPair = dir.endsWith('-pairs');
        const warnings: string[] = [];
        const parsed = looseOrPairBody(`/${dir}/${slug}`);
        const weight = weightValueOf(slug.split('-')[0] ?? '');
        const tail = (slug.split('-').pop() ?? '').toUpperCase();
        const refText = isPair ? (isPrRef(tail) === null ? null : tail.toUpperCase()) : (isKRef(tail) === null ? null : tail.toUpperCase());
      
        if (parsed === null) {
          // Structurally unparseable weight/ref anchors: explicit UNKNOWN fields.
          return Object.freeze({
            fields: Object.freeze({
              ...emptyFields(),
              form: isPair ? 'pairs' : 'single',
              stoneWeightCt: ev(null, 0, 'UNKNOWN', 'slug weight token unparseable'),
              gemRefDerived: ev(null, 0, 'UNKNOWN', 'no trailing gem-ref token'),
            }),
            warnings: [`slug does not match the validated ${isPair ? 'pair' : 'loose-stone'} grammar: ${slug}`],
          });
        }
      
        // Variety = the directory's token run; it must be the body's tail run (V4).
        const dirTokens = dir.replace(/-(pairs|rings)$/, '').split('-');
        const varietyLen = dirTokens.length;
        const body = parsed.body;
        const tailRun = body.slice(body.length - varietyLen).join('-');
        const varietyOk = tailRun === dirTokens.join('-');
        if (!varietyOk) {
          warnings.push(`variety directory '${dirTokens.join('-')}' is not at the slug tail ('${tailRun}') — field quarantined for review`);
        }
      
        // Shape (optional) and origin (optional).
        let originValue: string | null = null;
        let colourStart = 0;
        if (parsed.shapeIndex !== undefined) {
          originValue = parsed.shapeIndex > 0 ? body.slice(0, parsed.shapeIndex).join('-') : null;
          colourStart = parsed.shapeIndex + parsed.shapeLen;
        } else if (originVocabulary !== undefined) {
          // Split the leading run by the longest known origin phrase (2-token,
          // then 3, then 1) — pass-1 vocabulary, deterministic.
          for (let len = Math.min(3, body.length); len >= 1; len -= 1) {
            const phrase = body.slice(0, len).join('-');
            if (originVocabulary.has(phrase)) {
              originValue = phrase;
              colourStart = len;
              break;
            }
          }
        }
        const shapeToken = parsed.shapeIndex !== undefined ? (body[parsed.shapeIndex] ?? '').toLowerCase() : null;
        const shapeValue = shapeToken !== null ? (SHAPE_VALUES.get(shapeToken) ?? null) : null;
        // Colour tokens = the run between the origin/shape end and the variety tail.
        const colourTokens = body.slice(colourStart, body.length - varietyLen).join('-');
        if (colourStart > body.length - varietyLen && colourStart <= body.length) {
          warnings.push('colour run overlaps the variety tail; colour not resolved');
        }
      
        const fields: ParsedUrlFields = Object.freeze({
          variety: ev(dirTokens.join('-'), varietyOk ? 1 : 0.75, 'EXTRACTED', varietyOk ? undefined : 'variety token run mismatch; see row warnings'),
          colour: colourTokens.length > 0 && colourTokens.length > 0 ? ev(colourTokens, 0.9, 'EXTRACTED') : null,
          form: isPair ? 'pairs' : 'single',
          stoneWeightCt: weight !== null && weight > 0 ? ev(weight, 1, 'EXTRACTED') : ev(null, 0, 'UNKNOWN', 'slug weight token unparseable'),
          origin: originValue !== null ? ev(originValue, 0.9, 'EXTRACTED') : null,
          shape: shapeToken !== null ? ev(shapeValue, 1, 'EXTRACTED') : null,
          cut: null,
          jewelleryType: null,
          designCode: null,
          metalCode: null,
          settingStyle: null,
          gemRefDerived: refText !== null ? ev(refText.toUpperCase(), 1, 'EXTRACTED') : ev(null, 0, 'UNKNOWN', 'no trailing gem-ref token'),
          gemRefObserved: null,
          derivedSku: null,
        });
        return Object.freeze({ fields, warnings });
      }
      
      // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // Setting field parsing
      // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
      
      function parseSettingFields(
        family: { readonly prefix: string; readonly jewellery: 'RING' | 'EARRINGS' | 'PENDANT' },
        slug: string,
      ): { fields: ParsedUrlFields; warnings: readonly string[] } {
        const tokens = slug.split('-');
        const warnings: string[] = [];
        // '...-setting-js<core><metal>' right-anchored; the SKU tail parses under
        // the validated grammar (metal codes carry digits, e.g. W10/Y18/SL).
        const skuToken = (tokens[tokens.length - 1] ?? '').toUpperCase();
        const settingIndex = tokens.length - 2;
        const jewelleryIndex = tokens.length - 3;
        const skuParsed = parseSkuString(skuToken);
        const settingShape = skuParsed !== null && skuParsed.family === 'SETTING' ? skuParsed : null;
      
        if (settingShape === null || settingIndex < 2 || jewelleryIndex < 1) {
          return Object.freeze({
            fields: Object.freeze({
              ...emptyFields(),
              form: 'settings',
              jewelleryType: ev(family.jewellery, 1, 'EXTRACTED'),
              stoneWeightCt: ev(null, 0, 'UNKNOWN', 'settings slug carries no weight token'),
              designCode: ev(null, 0, 'UNKNOWN', 'slug does not end in the js<core><metal> token'),
              metalCode: ev(null, 0, 'UNKNOWN', 'no SKU token'),
              derivedSku: ev(null, 0, 'UNKNOWN'),
              settingStyle: null,
            }),
            warnings: [`slug does not match the validated settings grammar: ${slug}`],
          });
        }
      
        const metalCode: MetalCode = settingShape.sku.metalCode;
        const designCode = composeDesignToken(skuToken);
      
        // metal phrase = the longest leading prefix match (3 -> 2 -> 1 tokens).
        let metalPhraseLength = 0;
        let metalPhrase = '';
        for (let len = 3; len >= 1; len -= 1) {
          if (len > jewelleryIndex) continue;
          const phrase = tokens.slice(0, len).join('-');
          if (METAL_BY_PHRASE.has(phrase)) {
            metalPhraseLength = len;
            metalPhrase = phrase;
            break;
          }
        }
        // Style tokens = between the metal phrase and the jewellery token;
        // '-setting' and the trailing jewellery token are anchors, so the style
        // phrase is the run between them.
        const styleTokens = tokens.slice(metalPhraseLength, jewelleryIndex);
        const stylePhrase = styleTokens.join('-');
        if (stylePhrase.length === 0) {
          warnings.push(`no style token in the settings slug: ${slug}`);
        }
        if (metalPhrase === '') {
          warnings.push(`metal phrase unresolved for slug: ${slug}`);
        }
      
        return Object.freeze({
          fields: Object.freeze({
            ...emptyFields(),
            form: 'settings',
            variety: ev(family.jewellery.toLowerCase(), 1, 'EXTRACTED'),
            stoneWeightCt: ev(null, 0, 'UNKNOWN', 'settings slug carries no weight token'),
            jewelleryType: ev(family.jewellery, 1, 'EXTRACTED'),
            designCode: ev(designCode, 1, 'EXTRACTED'),
            metalCode: ev(metalCode, 1, 'EXTRACTED'),
            settingStyle: stylePhrase.length > 0 ? ev(stylePhrase, 0.9, 'EXTRACTED') : ev(null, 0, 'UNKNOWN'),
            gemRefDerived: ev(null, 0, 'UNKNOWN', 'settings slugs carry no gem reference'),
            derivedSku: ev(designCode, 1, 'EXTRACTED'),
          }),
          warnings,
        });
      }
      
      // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // DYO field parsing
      // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
      
      /** 'JS<core><metal>' design-token text of a SETTING-only SKU token. */
      function composeDesignToken(skuToken: string): string {
        const parsed = parseSkuString(skuToken);
        if (parsed === null || parsed.family !== 'SETTING') {
          // the composable SETTING forms are the only valid inputs here
          throw new Error(`composeDesignToken: not a SETTING-only SKU token: ${skuToken}`);
        }
        return skuToken; // is already the canonical uppercase token
      }
      
      function parseDyoFields(path: string): { fields: ParsedUrlFields; warnings: readonly string[] } {
        const slug = path.split('/')[path.split('/').length - 1] ?? '';
        const tokens = slug.split('-');
        const warnings: string[] = [];
        const fields = emptyFields();
      
        // Right-anchored: '{...}-js<core><metal>-{K|PR}<digits>'.
        if (tokens.length < 2) {
          return Object.freeze({
            fields: Object.freeze({ ...fields, derivedSku: ev(null, 0, 'UNKNOWN', 'slug too short'), gemRefDerived: ev(null, 0, 'UNKNOWN') }),
            warnings: ['dyo slug is shorter than the minimum documented shape'],
          });
        }
        const skuToken = (tokens[tokens.length - 2] ?? '').toUpperCase();
        const refTail = tokens[tokens.length - 1] ?? '';
        if (!/^js\d+/i.test(skuToken)) {
          return Object.freeze({
            fields: Object.freeze({
              ...fields,
              form: 'single',
              derivedSku: ev(null, 0, 'UNKNOWN', 'slug tail is not the js<core><metal> SKU token'),
              gemRefDerived: ev(null, 0, 'UNKNOWN', 'no trailing gem reference'),
            }),
            warnings: [`slug does not end in the validated CONFIGURED SKU shape: ${slug}`],
          });
        }
        const skuParsed = parseSkuFromSlug(`${slug}`);
        if (skuParsed === null || skuParsed.family !== 'CONFIGURED') {
          return Object.freeze({
            fields: Object.freeze({
              ...fields,
              form: 'single',
              derivedSku: ev(skuToken, 1, 'EXTRACTED'),
              gemRefDerived: ev(null, 0, 'UNKNOWN', 'trailing token is not a gem reference'),
            }),
            warnings: [`slug tail does not parse under grammar version 1: ${slug}`],
          });
        }
        const composition = skuParsed; // family CONFIGURED
        const metalCode = composition.sku.metalCode;
        const designCode = `JS${composition.sku.settingCore}${metalCode}`;
      
        // The metal phrase precedes the SKU token (1-3 tokens), matched from the
        // authoritative phrase list with the LONGEST candidate.
        let metalLen = 0;
        for (let len = 3; len >= 1; len -= 1) {
          const start = tokens.length - 2 - len;
          if (start < 0) continue;
          const phrase = tokens.slice(start, start + len).join('-');
          if (METAL_BY_PHRASE.has(phrase)) {
            metalLen = len;
            break;
          }
        }
        if (metalLen === 0) {
          warnings.push(`metal phrase unresolved before the SKU token: ${slug}`);
        }
        const weightIdx = tokens.length - 2 - metalLen - 1;
        const weightValue = weightIdx >= 0 ? weightValueOf(tokens[weightIdx] ?? '') : null;
        const head = tokens.slice(0, weightIdx === -1 ? 0 : weightIdx).map((t) => t.toLowerCase());
      
        // Head tokens: [{colour?}]-[{variety?}]-[{jewellery}]-[{shape}.]
        let jewelleryToken: string | null = null;
        for (const token of head) {
          if (JEWELLERY_VALUES.has(token)) jewelleryToken = token;
        }
        // shape: longest adjacent phrase first (2 -> 1 tokens).
        let shapeToken: string | null = null;
        {
          let i = 0;
          while (i < head.length) {
            const twoToken = `${head[i] ?? ''}-${head[i + 1] ?? ''}`;
            if (head[i + 1] !== undefined && SHAPE_VALUES.has(twoToken.toLowerCase())) {
              shapeToken = twoToken;
              i += 2;
              continue;
            }
            const single = head[i] ?? '';
            if (SHAPE_VALUES.has(single)) shapeToken = single;
            i += 1;
          }
        }
        // Variety = the head run; colour = the leading part of the same run where
        // the variety phrase is NOT directory-anchored (see V4 note): both stay
        // EXTRACTED-but-flagged; the canonical stages resolve variety through the
        // stone's OWN loose-stone URL, so this is display-labour only.
        const varietyPhrase = (() => {
          const st = shapeToken;
          if (st === null) return head.join('-');
          const parts = st.split('-');
          if (parts.length === 2) return head.slice(0, head.length - 2).join('-');
          return head.slice(0, head.length - 1).join('-');
        })();
        const colourPhrase = ''; // not resolved here; the canonical stage owns it
      
        return Object.freeze({
          fields: Object.freeze({
            ...fields,
            form: 'single',
            variety: varietyPhrase.length > 0 ? ev(varietyPhrase, 0.75, 'EXTRACTED', 'dyo slug variety is not directory-anchored; canonical variety resolves via the stone row') : null,
            colour: colourPhrase.length > 0 ? ev(colourPhrase, 0.75, 'EXTRACTED') : null,
            stoneWeightCt: weightValue !== null && weightValue > 0 ? ev(weightValue, 1, 'EXTRACTED') : ev(null, 0, 'UNKNOWN', 'dyo slug weight token unparseable'),
            shape: shapeToken !== null ? ev(SHAPE_VALUES.get(shapeToken) ?? '', 1, 'EXTRACTED') : null,
            jewelleryType: jewelleryToken !== null ? ev(JEWELLERY_VALUES.get(jewelleryToken) ?? '', 1, 'EXTRACTED') : ev(jewelleryFromRef(refTail, path), 1, 'EXTRACTED'),
            designCode: ev(designCode, 1, 'EXTRACTED'),
            metalCode: ev(metalCode, 1, 'EXTRACTED'),
            gemRefDerived: ev(composition.gemstone.gemRef.toUpperCase(), 1, 'EXTRACTED'),
            gemRefObserved: null,
            derivedSku: ev(designCode.toUpperCase(), 1, 'EXTRACTED'),
          }),
          warnings: warnings.length > 0 || head.length === 0 ? [...warnings, 'dyo slug carries no descriptive head tokens'] : warnings,
        });
      }
      
      function jewelleryFromRef(refTail: string, path: string): 'RING' | 'PENDANT' | 'NECKLACE' | 'EARRINGS' {
        if (isPrRef(refTail) !== null) return 'EARRINGS';
        // per SoT: K references appear on ring, pendant and necklace only; the
        // split between those is resolved by the observed DYO jewellery token —
        // when that is absent, the slug lives in the review family (ring default
        // is refused; the canonical stone row resolves the true value).
        void isJRef;
        void path;
        if (/ring/.test(path.toLowerCase())) return 'RING';
        if (/pendant/.test(path.toLowerCase()) && !/necklace/.test(path.toLowerCase())) return 'PENDANT';
        if (/necklace/.test(path.toLowerCase()) && !/pendant/.test(path.toLowerCase())) return 'NECKLACE';
        return 'RING';
      }
      
      // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // Ready-made field parsing
      // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
      
      function parseReadyMadeFields(dir: string, slug: string): { fields: ParsedUrlFields; warnings: readonly string[] } {
        const tokens = slug.split('-');
        const tail = tokens[tokens.length - 1] ?? '';
        const jDigits = isJRef(tail);
        const fields = emptyFields();
        // Weight token (may be the literal '0.00ct'); metal phrase after it.
        let weightIdx = -1;
        for (let i = 0; i < tokens.length; i += 1) {
          if (weightValueOf(tokens[i] ?? '') !== null) {
            weightIdx = i;
            break;
          }
        }
        let metalLen = 0;
        for (let len = 3; len >= 1; len -= 1) {
          const start = (weightIdx === -1 ? tokens.length - 2 : weightIdx) + 1;
          if (start + len > tokens.length - 1) continue;
          const phrase = tokens.slice(start, start + len).join('-');
          if (METAL_BY_PHRASE.has(phrase)) {
            metalLen = len;
            break;
          }
        }
        // Shape: exact token among the head tokens (before the weight).
        let shapeToken: string | null = null;
        const head = tokens.slice(0, weightIdx === -1 ? tokens.length : weightIdx).map((t) => t.toLowerCase());
        for (let i = head.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
          const t = head[i] ?? '';
          if (SHAPE_VALUES.has(t)) {
            shapeToken = t;
            break;
          }
        }
        // jewellery-type token phrase: the head tokens between the variety start
        // and the shape; e.g. 'ring', 'earring', 'necklace pendant'.
        const dirTokens = (dir.replace(/-rings$/, '') ?? '').split('-');
        return Object.freeze({
          fields: Object.freeze({
            ...fields,
            form: 'rings',
            variety: ev(dirTokens.join('-'), 1, 'EXTRACTED'),
            stoneWeightCt:
              weightIdx >= 0 && weightValueOf(tokens[weightIdx] ?? '') !== null
                ? ev(weightValueOf(tokens[weightIdx] ?? ''), 1, 'EXTRACTED')
                : ev(null, 0, 'UNKNOWN', 'ready-made slug carries no weight token (the observed 0.00ct shape takes it from a join)'),
            origin: null,
            shape: shapeToken !== null ? ev(SHAPE_VALUES.get(shapeToken) ?? '', 1, 'EXTRACTED') : null,
            jewelleryType: ev('RING', 1, 'EXTRACTED', 'ready-made family jewellery type is RING by the route family'),
            designCode: ev(null, 0, 'UNKNOWN', 'ready-made SKUs are J<digits>; no js design token'),
            metalCode: metalLen > 0 ? ev(METAL_BY_PHRASE.get(tokens.slice(0, metalLen).join('-')) ?? '', 0.9, 'EXTRACTED') : null,
            gemRefDerived: jDigits !== null ? ev(`J${jDigits}`, 1, 'EXTRACTED') : ev(null, 0, 'UNKNOWN', 'no trailing J ref'),
            gemRefObserved: null,
            derivedSku: null,
          }),
          warnings: jDigits === null ? [`slug does not end in the J<digits> shape: ${slug}`] : [],
        });
      }
      
      // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // The classifier entry point
      // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
      
      /** The bare path of a captured URL (origin + optional query stripped off). */
      export function barePathOf(url: string): { path: string; query: string } {
        const m = /^https?:\/\/[^/]+(\/\S*)$/.exec(url);
        const whole = m?.[1] ?? url;
        const q = whole.indexOf('?');
        return q === -1 ? { path: whole, query: '' } : { path: whole.slice(0, q), query: whole.slice(q + 1) };
      }
      
      const FUNCTIONAL_ROUTES_SET: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set([
        '/',
        '/cart',
        '/cart/order-summary',
        '/cart/payment-order',
        '/cart/secure-payment',
        '/account',
        '/auth',
        '/verify-email',
        '/favorites',
        '/compare-list',
        '/financing',
        '/extend-protection-plan',
        '/contact-us',
        '/showroom',
        '/showroom/preview',
        '/showroom/preview/success',
        '/blog',
        '/meet-our-team',
        '/michael-arnstein',
        '/custom-design-gemstone-rings-jewelry',
        '/sitemap-static.xml',
      ]);
      
      /** Classify + parse ONE URL. Pure; the origin vocabulary only bounds ambiguity. */
      export function classifyUrl(url: string, originVocabulary?: ReadonlyMap<string, unknown>): ParsedUrl {
        const { path, query } = barePathOf(url);
      
        if (path.startsWith('/design-your-own/review/')) {
          const p = parseDyoFields(path);
          return finish(url, 'DYO', p.fields, p.warnings, query);
        }
        for (const family of SETTING_ROUTE_FAMILIES) {
          if (path.startsWith(family.prefix)) {
            const p = parseSettingFields(family, path.split('/')[path.split('/').length - 1] ?? '');
            return finish(url, 'SETTING', p.fields, p.warnings, query);
          }
        }
        const m = /^\/([a-z0-9-]+)\/([a-z0-9.-]+)$/.exec(path);
        if (m !== null) {
          const dir = m[1] ?? '';
          const slug = m[2] ?? '';
          const tail = slug.split('-').pop() ?? '';
          if (dir.endsWith('-pairs') && isPrRef(tail) !== null) {
            const p = parseLoosePairFields(dir, slug, originVocabulary);
            return finish(url, 'STONE_PAIR', p.fields, p.warnings, query);
          }
          if (dir.endsWith('-rings') && isJRef(tail) !== null) {
            const p = parseReadyMadeFields(dir, slug);
            return finish(url, 'READY_MADE', p.fields, p.warnings, query);
          }
          if (isKRef(tail) !== null) {
            const p = parseLoosePairFields(dir, slug, originVocabulary);
            return finish(url, 'LOOSE_STONE', p.fields, p.warnings, query);
          }
        }
        if (FUNCTIONAL_ROUTES_SET.has(path)) {
          return finish(url, 'FUNCTIONAL', emptyFields(), [query ? 'query-string variant preserved (no family parse)' : 'documented functional route'], query);
        }
        if (path.startsWith('/education')) {
          return finish(url, 'EDUCATION', emptyFields(), ['education content route'], query);
        }
        if (path.endsWith('.xml')) {
          return finish(url, 'FUNCTIONAL', emptyFields(), ['sitemap route (generated, not migrated)'], query);
        }
        if (/^\/[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(path)) {
          if (path.endsWith('-gemstones') || path.endsWith('-pairs') || path.endsWith('-rings') || path.startsWith('/all-') || path.startsWith('/gemstone-')) {
            return finish(url, 'CATEGORY_INDEX', emptyFields(), ['category index route'], query);
          }
          return finish(url, 'VARIETY_INDEX', emptyFields(), ['variety index route'], query);
        }
        const fields = Object.freeze({
          ...emptyFields(),
          stoneWeightCt: (() => {
            const slug = path.split('/')[path.split('/').length - 1] ?? '';
            const w = weightValueOf(slug.split('-')[0] ?? '');
            return w !== null && w > 0 ? ev(w, 0.9, 'EXTRACTED') : ev(null, 0, 'UNKNOWN');
          })(),
        });
        return finish(
          url,
          'UNKNOWN',
          fields,
          [query ? 'query-string variant preserved; path matches no documented family (misfiled disposition)' : 'path matches no documented URL family (misfiled; quarantined)'],
          query,
        );
      }
      
      function finish(
        url: string,
        family: UrlFamily,
        fields: ParsedUrlFields,
        warnings: readonly string[],
        query: string,
      ): ParsedUrl {
        const all = [...warnings];
        if (query) all.push(`query-string preserved: ?${query.split('=')[0] ?? ''}=`);
        return Object.freeze({
          sourceUrl: url,
          family,
          routeDepth: barePathOf(url).path.split('/').filter((s) => s.length > 0).length,
          fields,
          warnings: Object.freeze(all),
          confidence: minConfidence(fields),
        });
      }
      
  referencedBy: {}

      /**
       * packages/db/src/pool.ts
       *
       * The one place a connection pool is created. The API composition root
       * (apps/web) may not import the `pg` driver (technical_design/03 forbidden
       * imports, enforced by ESLint) — it calls THIS factory and passes the opaque
       * pool to `createCatalogDatabase(pool)` / `createCatalogQueryPort(db)`.
       *
       * Pool discipline: small, localhost/dev sized; a cache or HTTP concern must
       * never reach into the pool (Redis is not this package's business).
       */
      import { Pool } from 'pg';
      
      export interface CreatePoolOptions {
        /** Max clients (default 10 — the API process is read-only and small). */
        max?: number;
        /** Statement timeout in ms; catalogue reads are indexed and short (default 5s). */
        statementTimeoutMs?: number;
      }
      
      export function createPool(databaseUrl: string, options: CreatePoolOptions = {}): Pool {
        return new Pool({
          connectionString: databaseUrl,
          max: options.max ?? 10,
          statement_timeout: options.statementTimeoutMs ?? 5000,
        });
      }
      
  referencedBy: {}

The\n  // long source slug 301s to the composed `{sku}-{ref}` code; a request that\n  // already IS the code re-computes to itself and the resolver's loop guard\n  // turns it into `served`.\n  const dyo = DYO_REVIEW.exec(p);\n  if (dyo !== null) {\n    const tokens = dyo[1]?.split('-') ?? [];\n    const sku = tokens[tokens.length - 2] ?? '';\n    const ref = tokens[tokens.length - 1] ?? '';\n    if (/^js\\d+[a-z]*\\d*$/i.test(sku) && /^(?:k|pr)\\d+$/i.test(ref)) {\n      return redirect(`/design-your-own/review/${sku.toUpperCase()}-${ref.toUpperCase()}`, 301);\n    }\n    // Under the DYO review prefix but not the documented shape: not ours.\n    return { disposition: 'unknown', decision: null };\n  }\n\n  // A new target-only route is never a legacy URL.\n  if (isNewRoute(p)) return served();\n\n  // Served directly: the target route is identical in shape (doc 34 section 2).\n  if (SERVED_DIRECTLY.has(p)) return served();\n\n  const fixed = FIXED_REDIRECTS.get(p);\n  if (fixed !== undefined) return { disposition: 'redirect', decision: fixed };\n\n  // Showroom family: /showroom/** -> /showrooms/**.\n  if (p === '/showroom') return redirect('/showrooms', 301);\n  if (p.startsWith('/showroom/')) return redirect(`/showrooms/${p.slice('/showroom/'.length)}`, 301);\n\n  // Generated sitemap family.\n  if (p === '/sitemap.xml') return served();\n  const sitemap = SITEMAP_PRODUCT.exec(p);\n  if (sitemap !== null) return redirect(`/sitemap-products/${sitemap[1] ?? ''}.xml`, 301);\n\n  // Collection family: /all-* -> /search?collection=all (temporary).\n  if (p.startsWith('/all-')) return redirect('/search?collection=all', 302);\n\n  // Stone families. Pairs first, then the loose-stone rule.\n  if (STONE_PAIR.test(p)) {\n    const slug = sourceSlugOf(p);\n    if (slug !== null) return redirect(`/products/${slug}`, 301);\n  }\n  if (READY_MADE.test(p)) {\n    // Target is the canonical products.slug — NOT derivable from the URL; the\n    // explicit `redirects` row owns this URL. Never guessed here.\n    return { disposition: 'needs-row', decision: null };\n  }\n  if (UNKNOWN_J.test(p)) {\n    // `/gemstone-bracelets-bangles/{slug}-J#####` and friends: the parser\n    // resolved no canonical entity, so no target resolves (doc 34 section 2).\n    return { disposition: 'removed', decision: { target: p, status: 410 } };\n  }\n  if (LOOSE_STONE.test(p)) {\n    const slug = sourceSlugOf(p);\n    if (slug !== null) return redirect(`/products/${slug}`, 301);\n  }\n\n  // Settings family: the SKU is the slug's trailing `js<core><metal>` token.\n  for (const re of [SETTING_RING, SETTING_NP, SETTING_EAR]) {\n    if (re.test(p)) {\n      const sku = p.slice(p.lastIndexOf('/') + 1).toUpperCase();\n      if (sku.startsWith('JS')) return redirect(`/settings/${sku}`, 301);\n      return { disposition: 'unknown', decision: null };\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Colour family. `/all-*` already ran, so this is a colour index.\n  const colour = COLOUR_INDEX.exec(p);\n  if (colour !== null) return redirect(`/colour/${colour[1] ?? ''}`, 301);\n\n  // Education and /gemstone-* category indexes keep their shape.\n  if (p.startsWith('/education')) return served();\n  if (p.startsWith('/gemstone-') && !p.slice(1).includes('/')) return served();\n\n  // Remaining depth-1 route: a variety / category index (shape unchanged).\n  if (!p.slice(1).includes('/')) return served();\n\n  return { disposition: 'unknown', decision: null };\n}\n\n/**\n * Apply the section 3 family rules. `null` when no family rule produces a\n * redirect (served directly, needs an explicit row, or unknown → 404).\n */\nexport function familyRedirect(pathname: string): RedirectDecision | null {\n  return classifyLegacyPath(pathname).decision;\n}",
      "allowMultiple": false
    }
  ]

'';\n    const withoutOrigin = url.replace(/^https?:\\/\\/[^/]+/, '');\n    const q = withoutOrigin.indexOf('?');\n    out.push({\n      url,\n      path: q === -1 ? withoutOrigin : withoutOrigin.slice(0, q),\n      search: q === -1 ?     The reason behind the renaming of middleware is that the term "middleware" can often be confused with Express.js middleware, leading to a misinterpretation of its purpose.
